headline: Flight Centre says unknown persons may have accessed a significant number of customer records in a third-party hotel booking system.
summary: New incident page. Flight Centre Travel Group's statement to the ASX (s001, copy on its investor site s002) says unusual activity in a third-party accommodation booking system used by the Flight Centre brand, Travel Associates, Cruiseabout and some independent agents may have exposed a significant number of customer records to unknown persons; most hold only names, a very small share includes limited passport details and other personal data; no card or bank details found. ABC News (s003) and The Register (s004) report the same. Main answer Confirmed on the company's own statement, filed under hack-stated; incident_type breach; no service, as nothing went down. Size Large: a major national travel retailer and a significant but uncounted number of records. The supplier is not named, so the users-of-the-supplier question is open (q003). Theory sweep: no Hacker News thread; Reddit not read. Privacy check done: the statement's media contact and reporters are not named.
